result:
I took the issue's second suggestion, a message that hints at a wrong course, and left the per-course screens alone. I didn't run the app or any tests.

In `config/locales/devise.pt-BR.yml` I added "Verifique se você está acessando o SAPOS do curso correto." to three messages:
- **Login errors:** both the invalid-credentials and the email-not-found messages now include it.
- **Password-reset confirmation:** this one reads "Caso não receba, verifique se você está acessando o SAPOS do curso correto."

I didn't add a visual identity for each course. The code has no per-course name setting. The page title is hard-coded as "Sapos" in `app/views/layouts/application.html.erb`. A visual identity would need a new configurable variable for the course name. I can add that and show it on the login page and layout if you want it.
